title: CARM1-expressing ovarian cancers are selectively sensitive to HSP70 inhibition.
snippet: High-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) remains the most lethal gynecologic malignancy, emphasizing the need for new targeted therapies. We recently identified CARM1-expressing HGSOCs as a distinct molecular subset associated with poor prognosis.
